parsed.text: Panel p0 gives fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. The current (completed_record, represented_time 12) distributions for both roles at every node are uniform over all 16 cells. Conditional candidate records (represented_time 13) are not executed events. Under command k0, n2’s blue mass concentrates on cells (row,col) (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) while n2 red concentrates on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); other nodes under k0 remain uniform. Under k1, n2’s blue peaks at (0,2) and red peaks at (0,1); other k1 nodes are uniform. Under k2 all nodes and roles are uniform. Copied prior records shown as inherited are not new estimates; conditional records are conditional forecasts, not observations.
